description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus replay-backed fragment composition, writable target-puzzle generation and staged diagnostic candidate search for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

assemblyLayout.transformOverrides: optional slot -> relativeTransform mapping used to materialize alternate historically observed geometry joins

candidateSolution.purpose: Convert a complete synchronized assembly layout into a writable Opus Magnum solution v7 for the target puzzle.

targetRemapping.inputs: branch chemistry is matched to ManufacturingPlan.atom_flows and input.which is rewritten to the target reagent index
targetRemapping.policy: historical fragment input/output indices are never trusted for a different target puzzle

normalization.armNumbers: positive sequential numbers for arm/piston/baron parts
normalization.metrics: empty for unsolved generated candidates; no fabricated solved metrics

engineValidationDiagnostics.purpose: Turn failed generated candidates into actionable search signals rather than a boolean failure.

temporalCandidateSearch.purpose: Search small relative timing variations around an empirical assembly without changing fragment-local programs or geometry.
temporalCandidateSearch.groups: branch-N and tail-N fragment instances move as units; convergence remains the timing anchor
temporalCandidateSearch.ordering: variants are enumerated by minimum total absolute displacement, with historical timing first

geometricCandidateSearch.purpose: Search alternate relative fragment placements using only transform variants observed in the replay-backed corpus.

choiceSources.convergenceInputs: relativeTransforms observed in convergence motif samples

geometricCandidateSearch.enumeration: bounded beam ordered by number of non-preferred joins, then aggregate log observation support
geometricCandidateSearch.historicalSafety: the preferred historical transform combination is always variant zero
geometricCandidateSearch.ranking: engine progress ranking shared with temporal search, with corpus support as a tie breaker

pipeline: if timing does not repair the candidate, optionally search observed relative-transform variants
composedGeneration.diagnosticPolicy: candidate failures are retained individually and normalized into failure modes so repair stages search the smallest deviation from empirical evidence first

remainingValidation: rebuild fragment/flow indexes from the local corpus using current schemas
exercise staged temporal/geometric search on reference campaign puzzles
combine geometry and timing search only after independent repair layers are measured
upgrade collision checking from origin overlap to exact occupied and swept geometry
